title: Recipe
description: A transition, authored by hand: lanes of breakpoints and timed events, in bars from the transition start (a phrase boundary on the outgoing deck). Hand-authored presets (contracts/recipes/) or compiled per pair by the Chunk 7 composer (then anchored). Read by web/src/coDJ (automation player) and the planner. Bump schema_version on any breaking change and update both readers.

description.description: One plain sentence: what the listener hears. Shown in the UI; also a fact the LLM may cite (Chunk 10).

bars.description: Length. The recipe ends (and cleans up) when the outgoing deck reaches this bar.

stems.description: Which decks need separated stems (every stem lane's deck must be covered).

beatmatchable.description: Both decks need a steady grid (they overlap in time).

max_camelot_distance.description: Max key distance (steps round the Camelot wheel, +1 for a major/minor change). null = any key.

command.description: play = start exactly on this bar (from the deck's nearest bar line); loop needs beats (loop size); brake (outgoing deck only) slows the deck to a stop over `beats` beats from this bar, like a turntable.

control.description: tempo (outgoing deck only, ramps only, no steps): the tempo fader, 0..1 = -8%..+8%. Before its first change the player keeps the deck's current tempo, so a ride starts from wherever the deck is.

points.description: [bar, value 0..1], bars non-decreasing. Two points at the same bar = a step (lands exactly on the bar); otherwise linear. Held before the first and after the last point. xfader values run out (0) -> in (1).

anchor.description: Composed recipes are written for one pair: the transition starts when the outgoing deck reaches out_start_bar (a phrase start), and the incoming deck plays from in_from_bar. Presets have no anchor: they start on the outgoing deck's next phrase, and the incoming deck plays from where it is.

out_track.description: Track id the anchor refers to (outgoing).

in_track.description: Track id the anchor refers to (incoming).
